domain.title: Official government websites end with .gov.my
domain.content: If the link does not end with .gov.my, exit the website immediately even if it looks similar.

security.title: Secure websites use HTTPS
security.content: Look for a lock or https:// as an added precaution. If not present, do not share any sensitive information.
